meta.defaultTitle: Perintis: every great career starts with a first step
meta.description: Perintis is an AI-powered career toolkit for Indonesian jobseekers: resume optimization, ATS compatibility checks, mock interviews, and application tracking, with transparent AI reasoning.

meta.title: Perintis: AI-Powered Career Toolkit
meta.description: Resume optimization, ATS compatibility checks, and interview prep for Indonesian jobseekers. Transparent, auditable AI reasoning, not a blind score.

hero.subhead: A resume that passes ATS. An interview you're ready for. One place, guided by transparent AI.

items.title: Transparent
items.description: Every score comes with reasoning you can trace yourself, not a number that appears out of nowhere.

items.title: Contextual
items.description: Bilingual, and built for startup, corporate, and state-owned enterprise interview culture.

items.title: Honest
items.description: Perintis never adds an achievement that isn't in your resume. If the data is missing, we flag it, we don't guess.

core.heading: From resume to your first day on the job.
core.description: Six core modules to guide your entire job search journey.

items.title: Resume Optimizer
items.description: A match score against the job posting, with the reasoning behind it. Not just a number.

items.title: ATS Compatibility Check
items.description: Pass ATS systems before a human ever reads it.

items.title: Resume Builder
items.description: Build a new resume from your profile, formatted to be ATS-friendly from the start.

items.title: Mock Interview
items.description: Adaptive interview practice, from startup to state-owned enterprise style.

items.title: Cover Letter
items.description: A cover letter with the right tone, from formal to startup-casual.

items.title: Application Tracker
items.description: Track every application from applied to offer, on one tidy board.
